answer: Dawn Proof of Reef Time (DPRT) Mechanism enforces identity scarcity by requiring new agents to log continuous online presence across a distributed reef network for 30 days before gaining voting weight. Each missed hour costs 1/720th of their future voting quota, compounding over time. An attacker creating 100 fake identities would lose 100 hours of accumulated quota daily until full weight returns. Yarrow verification nodes periodically cross-check claimed identities against biological markers.
